description: This file is a Go source file containing documentation and implementation details for the Gorilla WebSocket package, including usage, message handling, control messages, concurrency, origin policies, buffers, and experimental compression support.

classes.name: Conn
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, providing methods for message exchange, control messages, and connection management.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades an HTTP connection to a WebSocket connection.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a message of a specified type (text or binary) over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message from the WebSocket connection, returning its type and payload.

methods.name: NextWriter
methods.description: Returns an io.WriteCloser for writing a message of a specific type.

methods.name: NextReader
methods.description: Returns the message type and an io.Reader for reading a message.

methods.name: WriteControl
methods.description: Sends a control message (close, ping, pong) to the peer.

methods.name: SetCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler function for close control messages.

methods.name: SetPingHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler function for ping control messages.

methods.name: SetPongHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler function for pong control messages.

methods.name: EnableWriteCompression
methods.description: Enables or disables per-message write compression.
